authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL dvāra gives Prakrit bāra and Gujarati bār/bārũ door; its addendum explicitly supplies Gujarati bārṇũ and Sindhi Kachchhi bāyṇo door. These regional nasal-extension comparanda support survey barana/bayiṇo/bayiṇu/bayno and glottal baʔaṇo/baʔaŋo, with rhotic weakening or loss and source nasal notation qualified. The similar vāraṇa 11553 means obstruction and supplies an Old Marwari doorstep, not this door family. Local IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: barana.
